title: Generated AC1021 GROUP 2D/3D polyline strict DXF readback
scope: Extend the locally authored AC1021 GROUP parent/reactor control to convert both its 2D and 3D polyline variants through strict dwg2dxf, then read the DXF back through the concrete adapter and verify geometry plus group membership.

source.recipe: tests/dwg_ac1021_polyline_group_targets_tests.cpp writes vertex2d.dwg and vertex3d.dwg locally from scratch, with each GROUP containing the first polyline vertex
source.provenanceLimit: Locally authored writer controls only; does not establish independent producer or native consumer qualification. No drawing fixture was committed.

implementation.behavior: The existing generated GROUP test now strictly converts both local source variants, requires the 3D DXF subclass on the 3D output, and imports both DXFs through dx_iface. Fresh readback checks the exact two vertices, 2D/3D flags, Z coordinates (including 1.0 on the second 3D vertex), 3D vertex flags and unique GROUP_VERTEX membership pointing at the first vertex. The existing source DWG GROUP reactor rejection and same-planner retry remain in the same CTest.

validation.build: cmake -S . -B build-gcc -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 passed; dwg2dxf, adapter, source author and typed DXF readback test targets built.

focusedCtest.result: 1/1 passed in 1.35 seconds; generates both fixtures in CTest scratch and removes them afterward.

manualBinding.result: Both strict conversions succeeded and the fresh typed readback passed.

validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; the generated GROUP selector was the affected owning test.

limitations: This proves roundtrip transport for two locally authored AC1021 polyline variants and their one-member GROUP reference only.
It does not qualify independent DWG producers, arbitrary populated GROUPs, all 3D entity types, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD or native group/geometry semantics.
P4 source and graph closure, platform qualification, P7 independent 3D meaning and P8 consumer gates remain open.
nextAction: Continue P4 with an eligible source-bound graph from the existing candidate inventory; preserve refusals for candidates with unresolved parser, ownership or provenance gates.
